category.instructions: Classify the primary purpose of this customer feedback.

criteria.故障: An existing function fails or produces an incorrect result.
criteria.功能建议: A request to add or improve a capability.
criteria.使用咨询: A question about using an existing capability.
criteria.其他: The evidence does not support any of the other categories.

urgency.instructions: Score the impact actually described in the feedback; do not invent urgency or deadlines.
criteria: No reported disruption; a suggestion or ordinary usage question.
A minor disruption with a stated workaround.
An important workflow is blocked for the reporting user.
A widespread outage or explicitly reported loss of data or money.
